svg.title: SDLC plugin layers
svg.desc: Layer map of the sdlc plugin by structure. Top to bottom: 21 commands, 22 skills grouped by orchestrator stage, 13 agents, scripts, templates, and the files written into the user's repo. Hooks (security-guidance, hookify, verify-freshness, model-router with role-guard and trust-anchor, ralph-loop) run on six Claude Code events outside the stack. Packaging, tests, docs and licenses sit underneath.
svg.text: How sdlc 1.7.0 is built, from what the user types down to what lands in their repo. Each band is one plugin structure and arrows show who calls whom.
Hooks sit outside the stack because Claude Code fires them, not the workflow.
start hands the feature to the orchestrator; other commands load one skill or run a script
dispatch fresh subagents with a stage-specific brief
commands and skills (not agents) run these for facts the model should not guess
scaffold.py copies and tracks template files
generated and committed into the user's repo

g.text: Code events. They run whether or not a
warn or block before a tool
keeps sdlc agents to their role
